cards.text: Jesus is sending out His twelve disciples, and He's warned them: if the head of the house has been called Beelzebul, the prince of the demons (Matthew 12:24), His household will get it even more (Matthew 10:25). Then He says, "So do not be afraid of them." Baker, I spent years in the back of a junk drawer holding my breath every time it rattled open, so I need to hear this one TWICE.

cards.question: Jesus gives His disciples a reason not to fear the people against them. What does He say about everything concealed and hidden?

answers.text: It will all be made known
It will stay hidden for good

cards.text: Then Jesus talks about what He tells His disciples in the dark, the lean-in-close, whispered-in-your-ear stuff. The kind of thing you only tell your most trustworthy mixing bowl.

cards.question: True or false: Jesus tells His disciples to keep what He whispers to them a secret.

cards.text: Jesus tells them to speak in the daylight what He tells them in the dark, and to proclaim from the housetops what's whispered in their ear. The HOUSETOPS, baker, and I still whisper when I confess I ate the cookie dough.
Then Jesus tells His disciples not to be afraid of those who kill the body. I think this one is heavy to hear, but He says there's something they can't kill.

cards.question: Jesus tells His disciples not to be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the ___.
So instead of fearing those who kill the body, who does Jesus tell His disciples to fear?

answers.text: The One who can destroy soul and body
The governors who judge them in court
The councils that hand them over

cards.text: Then Jesus asks, "Are not two sparrows sold for a penny?" Two birds for ONE penny, baker, and you can't even get a single SPRINKLE for that.

cards.question: Two sparrows, one penny. True or false: Jesus says not one of them falls to the ground apart from the will of the Father.

cards.text: Then Jesus says even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Baker, I lose count of my chocolate chips after twelve, so that one gets me.

cards.question: Not one sparrow falls apart from the Father's will, and every hair is numbered. What does Jesus tell His disciples they're worth?

answers.text: About the same as two sparrows

cards.text: Then Jesus says everyone who confesses Him before men, He will also confess before His Father in heaven. Baker, my six cookie cutter kids called me Papa in front of the whole kitchen, and I STILL brag about it to the oven.

cards.question: Jesus promises to confess before His Father everyone who confesses Him before men. True or false: He says He will still confess before His Father whoever denies Him before men.

cards.text: Then Jesus says don't assume He came to bring peace to the earth. Baker, I just dropped my rolling pin, and it bounced off my gold base TWICE.

cards.question: Jesus says He has not come to bring peace. What does He say He has come to bring?

cards.text: Jesus says He has come to turn a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law, words from the prophet Micah (Micah 7:6). A man's enemies will be the members of his own household.

Then Jesus talks about loving father or mother, or son or daughter, compared with loving Him. Baker, I'm all ears on this one, because my whole night sky is shaped like my cookie cutter kids: Chip, Sparkle, Minty, Berry, Buttercup and Ruby.

cards.question: True or false: Jesus says anyone who loves father or mother, or son or daughter, more than Him is still worthy of Him.
Jesus says anyone who doesn't take up something and follow Him isn't worthy of Him. What does a follower take up?

cards.text: Then Jesus says whoever finds his life will lose it. Find it and LOSE it, baker, which is me and my oven mitts every single morning.

cards.question: And whoever loses his life for Jesus' sake will ___ it.

cards.text: Now Jesus talks about the people the disciples will meet out there, the ones who receive them and welcome them in. Baker, back in the junk drawer where I spent years, I WAS the welcome committee, a committee of one, greeting one very scared can opener.

cards.question: When someone receives the disciples, who else does Jesus say they receive?

answers.text: Jesus and the One who sent Him

cards.text: Then Jesus talks about someone who receives a prophet because he is a prophet. Baker, if a prophet knocked on my bakery door, I'd have him in an apron before he finished saying hello.

cards.question: Someone receives a prophet because he is a prophet. True or false: Jesus says that person will receive a prophet's reward.

cards.text: Same goes for receiving a righteous man because he is a righteous man. Then Jesus goes small, crumb-on-the-counter small: even a cup of cold water, given to one of these little ones because he's His disciple.

cards.question: Even for one cup of cold water given to one of Jesus' disciples, Jesus says the giver will never ___ his reward.
After Jesus finishes instructing His twelve disciples, what does He do next?

answers.text: Teaches and preaches in their cities
Rests for a while in Capernaum
Goes up a mountain alone to pray
